# The patterns a caller builds, and the Masker that scans with none.
#
# Nothing is enabled implicitly: a Masker scans with the patterns it was given
# and no others, which the case masked with no pattern at all states.

patterns: regexp

case: a pattern built from a regular expression
in:   token: INT-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef
out:  token: «internal-token»

case: every match of a regular expression
in:   first=INT-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef second=INT-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef
out:  first=«internal-token» second=«internal-token»

case: a regular expression that matches nothing
in:   token: INT-not-hexadecimal
out:  token: INT-not-hexadecimal

case: a github token is left alone by a pattern that does not know it
in:   ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz
out:  ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz

patterns: regexp-mask-group

case: a mask group redacts the value and leaves what named it
in:   user_id=12345 name=alice
out:  user_id=«user-id» name=alice

case: a mask group in every match
in:   user_id=1 user_id=22 user_id=333
out:  user_id=«user-id» user_id=«user-id» user_id=«user-id»

case: a mask group that matches nothing to redact
in:   user_id= name=alice
out:  user_id= name=alice

patterns: func

case: a pattern built from a function
in:   password=s3cr3t-value
out:  password=«shared-secret»

case: a value known only at run time, twice
in:   first=s3cr3t-value second=s3cr3t-value
out:  first=«shared-secret» second=«shared-secret»

case: a function that finds nothing
in:   password=something-else
out:  password=something-else

patterns: default-and-regexp

case: a built-in pattern and one of the caller's on one line
in:   github=ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz internal=INT-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef
out:  github=«github-token» internal=«internal-token»

case: the caller's pattern first
in:   internal=INT-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef jwt=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef
out:  internal=«internal-token» jwt=«jwt»

case: nothing either kind of pattern knows
in:   user=alice role=admin
out:  user=alice role=admin

patterns: none

case: a masker given no pattern redacts nothing
in:   GITHUB_TOKEN=ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz
out:  GITHUB_TOKEN=ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz

case: a masker given no pattern leaves a jwt alone
in:   eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef
out:  eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef
